<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex212-2024-10-08-15-12" status="reviewed"> de lta yin dang 'dir <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3809">kha 1</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="3809">jo btsun khyung</rs></note> na re dal ba dang 'byor pa ni tha dad pa ni ma yin te | mi khom pa brgyad las log pa yang de'i rang gi 'byor pa lnga las gzhan ma yin pa'i phyir dang | gnas la dad pa yang bsam pa yin pas lus kyi rten du bsdu bar mi 'thad <lb n="5b2"/> pa'i <abbr>phyir ro</abbr> ||
            des na 'dir dal 'byor ni 'grel pa byed pas mi khom pa brgyad spangs te khom ldan zhes bshad pa ltar yin la de nyid lung gzhan gyis phun sum 'tshogs pa ×bcur bshad pa yang yod do zhes <abbr>zer ro</abbr> ||</seg></TEI>
